implementation: 23 admin business callables; notification and coin campaigns run through the local worker
schemaReference: For callable X, use #/$defs/XRequest and #/$defs/XResponse in schemas
requires: Firebase Auth token, admin === true and active accountAccess checked by server

mapping.search: 2-100 trimmed characters; private indexed scans bounded at 10000 rows/8 MiB/20 seconds per index; max 20 allowlisted users/content/battles route results with live identity privacy
mapping.notifications: Immutable real business/audit events, 30-day retention, max 5000 retained events; each admin UID has independent read IDs and publication watermark. Mark-all keeps the server snapshot cutoff across retries; delayed business events published later remain unread
mapping.audit: Actor/filter-bound 15-minute snapshots, numbered pages 10/20/50, actor/action/target/result/q/local date filters. Backend create-once audit IDs and bracketed writers prevent retry duplicates or torn totals
mapping.reports: Create with requestId returns metadata only; receive with reportId returns CSV columns/rows. Both recheck live access, actor ownership, 15-minute expiry and deletion privacy. Operation retains metadata only. Limits 5000 rows, 1 MiB CSV, under 2 MiB JSON and 20-second source capture; over-limit errors never truncate
mapping.questionVersion: Admin integer 1 corresponds to RTDB currentVersion v1; immutable questionVersions/id/v1 and questionAnswers/id/v1
mapping.options: Four stable IDs beginning with a letter or underscore; array maps to RTDB keyed options {optionId:{text,order:1..4}}
mapping.contentPublication: Draft/archived ancestors gate new session selection; descendant statuses and existing snapshots are retained
mapping.questionArchive: Archive creates a new integer version as well; stale saves cannot republish using the previous expectedVersion
mapping.listening: TTS audioText only; audioUrl must be empty; file uploads are deferred
mapping.ongoingBattle: Canonical ready/active maps to ongoing. phase ready/playing follows source; reconnecting means an active room has a heartbeat overdue by RECONNECT_MS and awaits engine reconciliation. Reads never resolve deadlines
mapping.battleScores: Live scores include only mutually resolved earlier rounds; terminal scores use frozen finish.correct, with settled correctCounts only as a legacy fallback
mapping.battleHistory: Quick only. Normal endings, leave, disconnect and account_unavailable map to completed; both_left, both_disconnected and ready_timeout map to abandoned. Neither mapping changes the frozen outcome
mapping.battleDetail: Participants expose id/code/name/status only. Timeline is a whitelist of recorded room events and battleLogs, with fixed messages and no synthetic entries
mapping.activityIdentity: Stable SHA256 of type + UID + source attemptId; registration uses UID. Study/reporting retries overwrite one projection row. Names resolved at read time
mapping.monitoringFreshness: Page asOf is the start of the last completed discovery pass; lagMs is elapsed time since it. Total is exact for the bounded index snapshot. Source is eventually consistent; detail reads the current room without settlement
mapping.overview: Published aggregate generations only. totalUsers=current nondeleted retained Auth accounts at cutoff; newUsers/series count retained Auth registrations. Learning includes PRACTICE/TEST/DAILY. Completed quick rooms count once using the same completed/abandoned classification as Battles; activities count both UIDs
mapping.overviewAccuracy: Sum correct / sum adjudicated answer slots for learning/battle sessions finalized in period, including partial abandoned sessions. Skill allocation uses frozen question snapshots; unavailable details produce N/A rather than invented allocation
mapping.overviewCompletion: Completed as of generation cutoff / sessions started in selected local-day cohort. One battle is one session. Missing historical starts make affected rates null. Completion and accuracy have different documented cohorts
mapping.overviewActive: Distinct UIDs with recorded starts, room entry, committed answer times or terminal events in the range; union UID sets across days. Skill filters include mixed sessions involving that skill, while answer counts use actual question skill
mapping.overviewRebuild: Leased paged backfill into an isolated generation, stable fact/day receipts, atomic publication. Old complete generation remains readable. asOf is capture cutoff; eventual consistency and coverage are explicit. Retired generations expire after 24h
mapping.privateContent: Admin question/answer payloads are returned only by authorized API, not public catalog reads
mapping.pagination: Page numbers require bounded server snapshots/indexes; response page includes snapshotId, expiresAt, nextCursor; do not download the root
mapping.editRevision: Profile/User/Content responses carry revision; edits and status changes require expectedRevision. Question edits require expectedVersion
mapping.notificationsReadAll: Provide exactly one of id or throughAt; throughAt is the fixed read-all cutoff, retained over retries
mapping.export: requestId is required, query contains filters only, no page/pageSize/cursor/snapshotId; never silently truncate
mapping.operationResponse: All mutations and exports include operationId; successful replay returns the original stored envelope

errors.unauthenticated: Missing, invalid, expired or revoked token; sign in again
errors.permission-denied: Claim is not boolean true in token/current Auth, account disabled or access not active
errors.invalid-argument: Schema, cross-field validation or bounds failed
errors.already-exists: request-id-conflict, or a business uniqueness conflict
errors.failed-precondition: version-conflict, admin-self-protection, operation-result-expired or blocked operation requiring server review
errors.resource-exhausted: Rate or report bounds exceeded; retryAfterMs when applicable
errors.aborted: Operation pending, target busy or lease lost; retry the SAME requestId and payload
errors.unavailable: Temporary service failure; preserve input and requestId
errors.unimplemented: Business handler is not available in the current implementation
errors.internal: Response contract failed; no source record or server exception is returned
